description: This file defines the ChangesModel class, which manages a collection of change requests such as add, remove, move, optimize, copy, and merge network requests within a project. It provides methods to parse configuration files and store different types of change requests for subsequent processing.

classes.name: ChangesModel
classes.description: Singleton class that encapsulates a collection of change requests including add, remove, move, optimize, copy, and net merge requests. Responsible for reading and parsing configuration files that specify these changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ChangesModel.

methods.name: readConfiguration
methods.description: Reads a configuration file containing change commands and processes its content.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Parses a list of command lines representing change requests and populates internal data structures.

methods.name: addMoveRequest
methods.description: Adds a move request from a string request line.

methods.name: addAddRequest
methods.description: Adds an add request from a string request line.
